mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_refund WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM s_refund WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id, r.refund_no AS businessNo, r.booking_id AS bookingId, b.booking_no AS bookingNo, b.venue_id AS venueId, b.venue_name AS venueName, r.amount_fen AS amountFen, r.status, r.retry_count AS retryCount, r.next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, r.last_failure_reason AS lastFailureReason, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM s_refund r JOIN s_booking b ON b.id = r.booking_id WHERE r.status IN ('PROCESSING', 'FAILED') ORDER BY r.updated_at, r.id
SELECT id FROM s_refund WHERE status IN ('PROCESSING', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
